FAIL_TO_PASS: name-conflict-promise: avoids name conflicts with local variables named Promise
facade-reexports: handles reexports when creating a facade chunk and transitive dependencies are not hoisted
inlined-dynamic-namespace-compact: properly resolves inlined dynamic namespaces in compact mode
nested-inlined-dynamic-import-2: deconflicts variables when nested dynamic imports are inlined

dynamic-import-this-function: uses correct "this" in dynamic imports when not using arrow functions
include-dynamic-import-properties-await: includes used dynamic import properties with await
dynamic-import-default-mode: adds Symbol.toStringTag property to dynamic imports of entry chunks with default export mode
dynamic-import-this-arrow: uses correct "this" in dynamic imports when using arrow functions
dynamic-import: supports dynamically importing a module with synthetic named exports
dynamic-import-default-mode-facade: handles dynamic imports from facades using default export mode
chunking-duplicate-reexport: handles duplicate reexports when using dynamic imports
load-resolve-dependencies: allows to wait for dependency resolution in this.load to scan dependency trees
preserve-modules: handles a dynamic import with synthetic named exports in preserveModules mode
catch-dynamic-import-failure: allows catching failed dynamic imports
dynamic-imports-shared-exports: allows sharing imports between dynamic chunks
